title: Chicken Paprika Soup
steps: Heat a pot over medium heat. Add olive oil and sauté the onion and garlic until soft.
Add water to cover the onion, place the chicken in the pot, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for about an hour or until the chicken is tender and the sauce thickens slightly.
Stir in paprika and season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot.

title: Freshly Grilled Salmon with Lemon-Dill Pan Sauce
steps: Preheat the grill or heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season both sides of the salmon with salt and pepper.
Drizzle the salmon fillet with olive oil, ensuring it is evenly coated on all surfaces.
Place the lemon slices cut-side down onto the hot pan or under the grill to add their zestiness.
Add the garlic cloves and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant. Add more if desired.

title: Basil-Parmesan Pasta
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with crushed tomatoes
steps: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
While pasta is cooking, sauté minced garlic in a skillet over medium heat for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add water and diced tomatoes to the skillet with garlic. Simmer for 10 minutes or until sauce has thickened slightly.
Drain the pasta and add it back into the skillet with the tomato sauce. Toss everything together to coat the pasta in the flavorful sauce.
Season the pasta with salt and pepper to taste, then garnish with fresh basil leaves before serving.
comment: Parmesano del titulo y ajo no aparecen en la lista.

title: Classic Chinese Fried Rice
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Sauté the carrots until soft, then add the eggs and cook for another 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice, breaking up any clumps with your fork. Add half of the soy sauce, mix well.
Add salt to taste, stir everything together gently. Cook covered for an additional 2-3 minutes or until heated through.

title: Beef and Potato Rosemary Soup
steps: Season beef with salt and pepper.
Cook beef in a large pot until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Add water to cover the beef and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour.
Peel potatoes and slice them into chunks.
Meanwhile, chop rosemary into small pieces.
Return chopped rosemary to pot with beef and potato. Simmer for an additional 30 minutes.

title: Garlic-Braised Chicken with Onion and Olive Oil
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chicken, sliced onion, and minced garlic. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cook until the chicken is browned on all sides and the onions are translucent.
Cover the skillet with a lid and reduce the heat to low. Simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the chicken is tender and cooked through.

title: Red Pepper and Onion Stir-Fry
steps: Chop the red pepper into small pieces.
Chop the onion into thin slices.
Heat olive oil in a wok or large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onions and red peppers, stir-fry for about 5 minutes until the vegetables are tender but still crisp.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Chicken and Tomato Stir-Fry
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet; cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes total.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. Add garlic to the same skillet and sauté for 30 seconds.
Add diced tomatoes and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Return the chicken to the skillet.
Pour in water; bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened slightly, about 15-20 minutes.
comment: Ajo no listado pero por lo demas coherente.

title: Garbanzo Bean and Tomato Pasta
steps: Rinse the garbanzo beans well.
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add the garbanzo beans and cook until tender, about 15 minutes.
While the beans are cooking, finely chop the tomatoes and sauté them in olive oil with minced garlic for 2-3 minutes.
